title: Run on the empty choice word
statement: For a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine $M$ and any configuration $c$ on a fixed input, the run of $M$ from $c$ under the empty choice word is $c$.
hypotheses_covered: nondeterministic machine M with k work tapes
configuration c on a fixed input
replaced:
Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine and $c$ a configuration of $M$ on
some input.  Running $M$ from $c$ under the empty choice word yields $c$ itself.
